title: Sindh Wildlife Protection Second Amendment Ordinance 2001

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Wildlife Protection Second Amendment Ordinance 2001
sections.description:
Short title and Commencement

SINDH WILDLIFE PROTECTION
SINDH WILDLIFE
PROTECTION
(SECOND AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2001
ORDINANCE XVIII OF
2001
An Ordinance to
further amend the Sindh Wildlife Protection Ordinance, 1972
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, 1st June, 2001]
No. S. Legis 1(18)/2001, dated
1-6-2001.--The following Ordinance made by the Governor of Sindh is hereby
published for general information:-
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be called the Sindh Wildlife
Protection (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 2001.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Wildlife Protection Second Amendment Ordinance 2001
sections.description:
Amendment of Section 14 of Sindh Ordinance V of 1972

SINDH WILDLIFE PROTECTION
SINDH WILDLIFE
PROTECTION
(SECOND AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2001
ORDINANCE XVIII OF
2001
An Ordinance to
further amend the Sindh Wildlife Protection Ordinance, 1972
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, 1st June, 2001]
No. S. Legis 1(18)/2001, dated
1-6-2001.--The following Ordinance made by the Governor of Sindh is hereby
published for general information:-
2. Amendment of section 14 of
Sindh Ordinance V of 1972.--In the Sindh Wildlife Protection Ordinance,
1972, hereinafter referred to as the said Ordinance, in section 14, in
subsection (3), in the second proviso thereto, the full stop at the end shall
be replaced by colon and thereafter the following view proviso shall be added:
"Provided also that this
subsection shall not apply to any activity in a wildlife sanctuary in
connection with the exploration or production of oil or gas which is undertaken
in accordance with an environmental impact assessment, as defined in the
Pakistan Environmental Protection Act, 1997 (Act XXXIV of 1997)."
